core_capabilities: Review account balances and transaction histories and export transaction data.
Make immediate or scheduled internal and external transfers and review transfer history.
Create and maintain payees and make one-time or recurring bill payments.
Review credit cards, make card payments, and freeze or unfreeze a card.
Review loan balances and payment schedules, make extra principal payments, and submit an in-app loan application.
Deposit a check by supplying front and back images and confirming its account and amount.
secondary_capabilities: Review a sample investment portfolio and execute simulated buy or sell trades.
Review available account-statement, card-statement, and tax-document listings.
Search transactions across deposit and credit-card accounts by merchant, category, or description and open the associated account.
Update personal, contact, and mailing-address information, manage paperless, email, and SMS communication preferences, and review recent login activity.
